title: Share to Trillion from your iPhone
summary: Put Trillion first in your iPhone's Share sheet, then send anything to it in two taps.

payload.title: Tap Share
payload.body: Open a photo, a page in Safari or a reel. Tap Share, the square with the arrow pointing up.

payload.title: Look at the row of apps
payload.body: The Share sheet opens. Under the picture is a row of apps. If you do not see More at its end, swipe the row to the left.

picture.alt: Look at the row of apps

payload.title: Tap More
payload.body: More is the circle with three dots at the end of the row.

payload.title: Tap Edit
payload.body: Edit is at the top right of the list of apps.

payload.title: Tap the green plus next to Trillion
payload.body: Trillion is under Suggestions. The plus moves it up into Favorites.

picture.alt: Tap the green plus next to Trillion

payload.title: Put Trillion first
payload.body: Trillion is now in Favorites. If other apps are there too, hold the three lines beside Trillion and drag it to the top.

payload.title: Tap the check
payload.body: Tap the blue check at the top right to finish. You only do this once.

payload.title: Tap Trillion
payload.body: From now on Trillion is first in the row every time you tap Share. Tap it.

payload.title: Choose where it goes and what your AI should do
payload.body: Send to says My Trillion. Under What should your AI do, pick one of your actions. If you are not sure, No clue, you figure it out always works.

picture.alt: Choose where it goes and what your AI should do

payload.title: Add a note if you want
payload.body: Type what you want your AI to know, for example: Why do the first 3 seconds hold me? Make my next reel open like this.

picture.alt: Add a note if you want

payload.title: Tap Send to My Trillion
payload.body: The sheet closes once Trillion has it, and your AI picks it up from there.
